images.caption: Figure 1:Comparison of Foresight VLA Models.(a) Existing methods typically adopt single-horizon foresight and directly feed predictions into VLA models without selective utilization. (b) In contrast, HiFOR combines multi-horizon foresight with action-guided retrieval of relevant future information.

Figure 2:The overview of HIFOR.(a) We augment the VLA with hierarchical foresight prediction and action-guided world retrieval, enabling the Action Expert to leverage future information during action generation. (b) Hierarchical Foresight Prediction (§3.4) predicts short-term, milestone, and goal futures through hierarchical dependency modeling. (c) Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling (§3.5) organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions. (d) Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval (§3.6) selectively retrieves action-relevant future information through denoising-aware factorized attention to guide action generation.

Figure 3:Hierarchical Foresight Planning Data Construction.(a) A planning agent generates semantic milestones from task instructions. (b) Automatic milestone localization identifies their completion timestamps in expert demonstrations using event evidence and temporal consistency checks.
Figure 4:Real-world evaluation results.We evaluate HIFOR against leading models on the Generalization and Long-horizon task suites.
